name: use-location-button
title: Use location button
description: A Use my location button that handles every outcome in words: finding you, found with its accuracy, blocked, unavailable and timed out.
docs: navigator.geolocation is called only when the button is pressed, never on load. onLocate receives latitude, longitude and accuracy in metres and nothing is sent anywhere; onError receives denied, unavailable or timeout. Where the Permissions API exists, a site that is already blocked says so before the first press. The button renders nothing where there is no geolocation. Pass geolocation to supply your own source (a native shell, or a stub to try every outcome), and labels to change the words.
